scope_statement: OCR GCSE English Literature J352, poetry component, 'Love and Relationships' cluster of the OCR Poetry Anthology 'Towards a World Unknown' Version 2 (first teaching September 2022). The cluster contains exactly these fifteen poems: 'A Song' by Helen Maria Williams; 'Bright Star' by John Keats; 'Now' by Robert Browning; 'Love and Friendship' by Emily Bronte; 'Looking at Your Hands' by Martin Carter; 'Love After Love' by Derek Walcott; 'Morning Song' by Sylvia Plath; 'Poem for My Love' by June Jordan; 'I Wouldn't Thank You for a Valentine' by Liz Lochhead; 'In Paris With You' by James Fenton; 'Flirtation' by Rita Dove; 'Warming Her Pearls' by Carol Ann Duffy; 'Dusting the Phone' by Jackie Kay; 'The Perseverance' by Raymond Antrobus; 'Lullaby' by Fatimah Asghar. Any other poem named as an anthology poem is out of scope, including the five withdrawn in Version 2 ('A Broken Appointment' by Thomas Hardy; 'Fin de Fete' by Charlotte Mew; 'The Sorrow of True Love' by Edward Thomas; 'An Arundel Tomb' by Philip Larkin; 'Long Distance II' by Tony Harrison) and any poem from another board's anthology.
